description:
The Bazecor configurator software allows you to remap any key and create up to 10 fully programmable layers for your Dygma Raise keyboard. It also allows you to create and manage superkeys, macros, and shortcuts.


Hello, everyone!
We're here with a new Bazecor update that adds more quality-of-life features for the new Layer Lens, as well as improved support for English US and Spanish symbols.
Layer Lens is now available for the Defy, Raise 2 and Sonsei. To use it, please update your firmware to the latest available version and activate Layer Lens following the instructions in the Settings menu.
Screenshot 2026-10-15 at 12 51 45
Updates to Layer Lens
- Added opacity controls to the tray app
- Added a timer slider for "Highlight Layer Change"
- Improved the legibility of the legends with lighter colors
- Fixed a bug where the keyboard could be shown twice on the Home Screen
- Fixed a bug where the tray app would prevent macOS from shutting down
- We added a Beta tag for Layer Lens in Settings, as we still need to fix some bugs and add support for more languages
Other changes included
- Removed the "True Sleep" option for the Dygma Sonsei, as it had no benefit over the standard battery management (it does on the Raise 2 and Defy)
- Added Flatpak support thanks to @mean-ui-thread and further refactoring thanks to @lbrooks
- Fixed a bug where the firmware menu indicated that there was a firmware update for the Sonsei, when there wasn't
Let us know what you think!
